input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is PAINTING STYLE ONLY, never copy its person, framing or pose. Keep the same face, headwear, clothes and single set of equipment. Non-magical Roman auxiliary slinger, plain head wrap, dull sand short tunic, leather sling visibly extended, stone pouch on hip, no helmet, compact light human silhouette; no magical aura. FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally TOWARD viewer and image RIGHT, face and front surfaces clearly visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 separate complete poses of ONE SAME character. Read left to right, top to bottom. Row 1: four keys of a QUICK FLINCH AND RECOVERY: 1 ready upright pose; 2 sharp unmistakable recoil with shoulders and head pulled BACK by one head-width and torso bent back 25 degrees; 3 shoulders returning and braced bent legs; 4 upright recovered ready pose. These four poses MUST visibly differ, not four standing duplicates. Row 2: first four keys of a BIGGER STAGGER: 5 upright ready; 6 abrupt backward bend of upper body; 7 deepest backward bend, arms pulled close, balance visibly lost; 8 lower body catches the weight, bent knees or legs. Row 3: 9 pushing back upright, visibly struggling; 10 upright recovered. Then begin COLLAPSE: 11 ready upright; 12 legs buckle and body drops. Row 4: continue COLLAPSE: 13 body very low, leaning toward ground; 14 torso falls sideways nearly horizontal; 15 body settles FULLY LYING on its side, head and entire torso on ground; 16 body completely still FULLY LYING ON GROUND, legs extended or naturally folded, equipment resting beside it. The final TWO poses must be completely horizontal resting bodies, never crouching, kneeling, sitting or getting back up. Treat collapse as a harmless theatrical fall/rest pose, fully intact. No blood, gore, wounds or injury detail. No attacker, impact flash or effects. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt:
Original painted game character animation sprite sheet on a solid, uniform vivid MAGENTA (#FF00FF) background. 4x4 grid layout with exactly 16 equal cells (4 columns, 4 rows), separated by wide, clean, empty magenta gutters. No grid lines, panel borders, frames, text, numbers, or UI elements.

Character Identity & Equipment (matching Reference-1):
A non-magical Roman auxiliary slinger with a compact, light human silhouette. Wearing a plain cloth head wrap (no helmet), a dull sand-colored short linen tunic, a leather stone pouch hanging at the hip, simple sandals, and holding a leather sling with cords visibly extended. No magical aura, glowing effects, extra weapons, or heavy armor.

Painting Style (matching Reference-2):
Dark fantasy hand-painted digital concept art style. Sculpted painterly volume, confident brushwork, opaque smooth paint, worn pale layered cloth, cool lighting from the upper-left, subtle contact shadows under feet. No 3D render, photorealism, heavy cartoon lineart, canvas texture, grain, or noise.

Perspective & Camera:
Elevated 55-degree orthographic view (high isometric 3/4 perspective). The character is consistently oriented in a FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, facing diagonally toward the viewer and to the right (South-East). Front torso and face remain visible in this anatomical perspective across all poses. All 16 poses maintain strictly identical anatomical scale, centered within the middle 60% of each cell, entirely within cell bounds without touching borders.

16 Poses (4x4 Grid, left-to-right, top-to-bottom):
Row 1 (Quick Flinch and Recovery):
- Cell 1: Upright ready stance, alert and balanced.
- Cell 2: Sharp hit flinch recoil: head and shoulders pulled back by one head-width, upper torso snapped back 25 degrees, arms reacting.
- Cell 3: Recoil momentum halting, shoulders returning forward, legs bent and braced.
- Cell 4: Recovered upright ready pose.

Row 2 (Deep Stagger):
- Cell 5: Upright ready stance.
- Cell 6: Abrupt heavy backward bend of the upper body.
- Cell 7: Deepest backward stagger: torso sharply arched back, arms pulled tight to chest, balance visibly broken and reeling backward.
- Cell 8: Lower body dropping low, deeply bent knees catching the falling weight.

Row 3 (Stagger Recovery to Collapse Start):
- Cell 9: Pushing back upright from the deep dip, visibly straining and off-balance.
- Cell 10: Fully recovered upright ready stance.
- Cell 11: Upright ready stance just before collapsing.
- Cell 12: Legs buckle underneath, knees give way, body drops halfway toward ground.

Row 4 (Defeat / Knockout Collapse):
- Cell 13: Body dropping very low near the ground, knees collapsed, torso tilting downward.
- Cell 14: Torso falling sideways, nearly horizontal, reaching toward ground.
- Cell 15: Body settled fully lying on side on the ground, torso and head flat against the floor plane, harmless theatrical resting pose (intact, fully clothed, no gore, no blood, no injury).
- Cell 16: Final still state: completely fully lying flat on side on ground, body motionless, limbs resting naturally, leather sling and pouch resting beside body on the ground.

Uniform bright solid magenta #FF00FF background across the entire sheet.
